name: Nike

window.note: Most Nike purchases, for any reason.

basis.note: The help page doesn't say whether 60 days counts from purchase or delivery.

conditions.value: Most purchases can be returned or exchanged within 60 days. Items marked Final Sale are excluded. Nike By You custom sneakers are included.

processing.value: Several business days after Nike receives it; your bank may take longer

categories.label: Nike Clearance store purchases
categories.note: Excluded from the 60-day Wear Test; their own terms weren't confirmed.

membership.effect: Free returns: Members can link the order to their Membership and get a prepaid shipping label. Non-members pay their own shipping when mailing a return.

timing.value: Several business days after Nike receives it; your bank may take longer

fees.label: Return shipping
fees.amount: Paid by non-members when mailing a return; free label for Members

methods.label: Mail it back
steps: Open your order in the Nike app or on nike.com and start a return
Members: link the order to your Membership to get a prepaid label
Pack the item and send it

unknowns.note: Purchase vs. delivery date not confirmed. Use the purchase date (earlier).
Whether online orders can be returned at Nike stores wasn't confirmed.

research: Official US pages read through web-search excerpts on 2026-10-11 (direct page downloads were blocked from the build environment). Spot-check before launch.
